nodes.title: Detail Daemon Settings
widgets_values:
Detail Amount: The main settings for the amount of "detail". Max 5 (which is A LOT of noise!). Can be negative. 0 disables.

Start / End: Typically better to give some room at the start and end for "normal" operations

bias: Shifts the _detail_amount_ in the middle steps forward or back in the generation process.

exponent: Changes the curvature of the adjustment. 0 is no curvature, 1 is smoothly curved.

fade: Reduce the entire adjustment curve by a particular value.

nodes.title: note ⬆️
widgets_values:
In the 2nd stage and refiner stage the denoise curve is trimmed, so the beta scheduler is not necessarily the standard for refinement. Explore variations in the tail of the curve in different schedulers.

when you find the right balance between step and denoise, follow this rule
math e.g.:
steps 8 denoise 0.3 >
8/0.3= total steps > total steps 26
start at step 26 - 8 = 16
end at step 26

>Don't accumulate too many steps below 0.12 (too much grain, chromatic aberrations), but not even above 0.45/0.50 (poor coherence, partially redraws the compositional elements)

>Experiment with other schedulers, being careful not to insist too much on the same sigma values
